title: 2022 CODATA: electron volt is 1.602 176 634 × 10^−19
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks electron volt as exact: 1.602 176 634 × 10^−19 J.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks electron volt as exact: 1.602 176 634 × 10^−19 J. No uncertainty is printed on that row. The electronvolt is an exact conversion in the 2022 listing because the elementary charge is an exact defining constant. The listing's unit is the joule.
